title: Offers: none yet
summary: DJDL's Offers before the first offer, right after the App Store connected: the kit's empty state says in one sentence that 3 of DJDL's App Store in-app purchases can be imported, and offers Import from App Store beside New offer.
compare: First-run empty state (EXPERIENCE.md §9): an icon in the Commerce tint, 'No offers yet', one sentence ('3 App Store in-app purchases can be imported.') and the two actions; no empty table, stats or filters.

The empty state's card (640px) sits in the middle of the canvas, across and down, never in its top-left corner (the owner, 2026-10-09: 'No offers yet should be centered'; kit: a page head then one empty-state card).
The page head keeps its title and sub-line but no actions while the empty state carries them, so New offer appears once.

Import from App Store names the store it reads (only connected storefronts with products are offered); with no store connected, only New offer shows and the sentence about existing in-app purchases is absent.
New offer opens the editor (commerce.offer-new); Import shows the suggestions (commerce.offers-import).
Phone: the empty state centres in its card and the two buttons stack, the primary on top.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink; focus, hover, checked and selected take the accent of the service the element references (B17), never a status colour; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

findings.issue: A 1262px panel with two lines floating at its top-left.
findings.resolution: Card capped at 640px and offset from the title; Import from App Store is primary, New offer secondary; counts match offers-import (4 found, 3 match).

findings.issue: [wide 1920] Console pages stretch tables and attention rows across the whole width.
findings.resolution: Page content is capped at 1280px, left-aligned, from 1600px (.cm2 page cap); attention text is capped at 72ch with its action beside it.
